title: Restore ThinkPad keyboard backlight after sleep and boot
body: On ThinkPads the keyboard-light key stays in firmware. It never hits the XF86Kbd bindings, so the level you set there was never saved. Unlock and boot then put 0 back. This watches `tpacpi::kbd_backlight/brightness_hw_changed`, stores that level, and writes it back at login and after resume. Unlock uses the same store, and only for this LED.
